evidence.quote: DENV serology tests were performed with anti-DENV IgG and IgM ELISA as previously described.
Reverse transcription-PCR was performed by using the DV1 and DV3 primer set and the ALD 1 and ALD 2 primer set in one reaction with details specified previously.

evidence.section: 2.3. Flow Cytometry Analysis and Cell Sorting for RNA Sequencing
evidence.quote: PBMCs were stained with anti-human CD3, CD4, CD8, CD14, CD19, CD56, and live/dead viability antibodies.
Samples were sequenced in 3 batches using a NovaSeq 6000 system (Illumina, San Diego, CA, USA) to obtain 50-bp paired-end reads.
